assay: bulk total RNA-seq (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA), human vastus lateralis biopsies, HISAT2/GRCh37 + HTSeq gene counts
sample_inclusion: 11 DM1 patients who completed 12 wk cycling (P10, P11 dropped out; S4.1.p1) biopsied pre and post; healthy inactive CON biopsied once at baseline (n = 10 sequenced; Fig 4 legend n = 10-11)
primary_estimand: Within-patient effect of 12 weeks of aerobic cycle training on vastus lateralis gene expression in DM1 patients (DM1-POST vs DM1-PRE, paired by patient) (S2.9.p1, Fig 4C)
planned_contrasts: DM1-POST vs DM1-PRE, paired (S2.9.p1, Fig 4C; paper: 18 up, 1 down)
DM1-PRE vs CON (S2.8.p1, Fig 4B; paper: 435 up, 205 down) - disease contrast, not an exercise effect
repeated_measure_unit: patient (pre/post biopsies from the same DM1 patient)
paper_method: DESeq2 accounting for group and paired sample design (S4.16.p1)

paper_results.POST_vs_PRE: 18 up, 1 down; ECM remodelling, angiogenesis, inflammation GO terms up
paper_results.PRE_vs_CON: 435 up, 205 down; snoRNAs/snRNAs up, splicing/OXPHOS/translation down
